description:
You are working on an Android app called 'ShopEasy' which is already open in Android Studio. The product team wants deep link support so users can open product pages directly from URLs.

Your task:

1. Create a new Kotlin file 'DeepLinkActivity.kt' at app/src/main/java/com/example/shopeasy/DeepLinkActivity.kt:
   - The class must extend AppCompatActivity
   - Override onCreate, call super.onCreate and setContentView with the layout R.layout.activity_deep_link
   - Extract the deep link URI from intent?.data
   - Extract the product ID from the URI's last path segment

2. Create a layout file 'activity_deep_link.xml' at app/src/main/res/layout/activity_deep_link.xml:
   - Use any standard root layout (ConstraintLayout, LinearLayout, etc.)
   - Include at least one TextView element

3. Update the existing AndroidManifest.xml (app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) to register DeepLinkActivity with a deep link intent filter:
   - <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
   - <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
   - <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />
   - <data android:scheme="https" android:host="shopeasy.example.com" android:pathPrefix="/product" />

4. The project must still build successfully after your changes. You can verify by building the project (Build > Make Project or Ctrl+F9).
